unresolved: Precise public numerical archaeological coordinates not verified for Watson Brake, Grand Caillou, Hillman, Morgan, Adams Bay, Belcher, Cedros sites or Hester. Keep individually named records unmapped; town/bayou centroids, tourist access points and monitoring stations are not settlements.
Bruly St. Martin1980 primary text unavailable. AD600–750 versus850 extension, four assays, material/calibration and coordinates require direct review; no synthetic interval added.
Kidder2010 direct access failed: four-site model, ten-year mound construction and2400–2100calBP recolonization need primary review. State2022 research plan supports qualified flood-gap context only.
Point Pleasant16IV199, Bayou Goula16IV11, Ellesley, Avery Island, Banana Bayou, Monte Sano and Conly details await dated contexts; no chronology derived solely from synopsis.
Faro Punta Marquez2026 exact10,600calBP and shellfish succession await primary journal text; author conference abstract used with explicit access limits.
Springer1980, Anderson2015 and Girard1999 full text not obtained. Register distinguishes metadata/abstract checks from full review.
Shell-versus-OSL mismatches need reservoir, reworking, deposition and uncertainty assessment. No universal older-than-landform rejection rule.
GSAJuly2003 header not resolved to an archaeology article; no settlement evidence attributed to it.
corrections: Neither dump establishes statewide first occupation11,500BCE or universal first coastal-bayou settlement afterAD1. Mehta2019 concerns Grand Caillou/Lafourche, not Paleoindian Louisiana.
Page-Ladson is Florida; Cooper’s Ferry Idaho; Hester Mississippi; Wapanocca Arkansas; Cedros/Faro Mexico; Dor an Israel comparison. Regional context is not a Louisiana dated settlement.
Hillman components do not establish uninterruptedAD1–1000 occupation. Cultural-period endpoints are not site founding/abandonment dates.
Landform emergence/OSL age is not occupation. Delta abandonment and truncation of dated activity may coincide without proving a single cause.
Saunders1997 seasonal use differs from2005 all-season basal evidence. Plants later domesticated are not thereby already proven crops at Watson Brake.
Watson Brake construction continued sometime after3000BCE. No hard3000BCE endpoint invented; ca3500BCE onset plotted as rounded reference only.
Trubitt2019 and Kassabaum2012 are book reviews. Zejdlik review is unrelated. Pringle1997 is news about the Science report, not independent excavation.
Girard1999 belongs to archaeological Caddoan literature/SFA ITA, not Theoretical Informatics and Applications. Belcher mound and Comegys village remain distinct.
Helmer online2022 is Holocene33(3)2023; Dor online2021 is Quaternary Research105(2022); Mehta online2025 appears in2026issue45(1).
Automated method labels, citation counts and rankings are not scientific confidence. Artifacts, mounds, rooms, genetic effective population and core ages are not resident totals.
Final abstract gives Colina Castor12,780–12,105calBP; earlier9755calBPtail not substituted. calBP normalized1950minusBP;14CBP never silently treated ascalBP.
